description: This file defines a custom Presenter for displaying video items as ImageCards in an Android TV application. It handles view creation, data binding with video thumbnails, and view cleanup, utilizing the Glide library for image loading.

classes.name: VideoCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter class for rendering video item cards with thumbnail images, titles, and descriptions for Android TV interfaces.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView, setting dimensions and focus properties.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a VideoItem to the ViewHolder, loading the thumbnail image with Glide and setting title and description texts.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears image resources from the view to prevent memory leaks.
